title: Relaxation
label: MOVIES & SERIES
description: A movie and series app with built-in playback, a personal library and offline downloads.
detail: Relaxation brings search, favorites and a built-in video player into one Flutter app for Windows and Android. Playback history, resume controls and an offline library help viewers continue across sessions.

title: ReGet
label: DATA RECOVERY
description: A data recovery app with filesystem discovery, file signature scanning and resumable recovery sessions.
detail: ReGet combines a Flutter interface with a Rust scanning engine to explore recoverable files on Windows and Android. Saved sessions, bounded file previews and licensed export support a structured recovery workflow.
note: Local scanning, resumable sessions and file previews lead into a licensed export workflow.

title: My POS
label: SALES & INVENTORY
description: A point-of-sale app for managing inventory, barcode sales, receipts and staff access.
detail: My POS supports retail and restaurant sales workflows with inventory controls, receipts and sales reports on Windows and Android. Staff roles and encrypted local storage complement Firebase account and database services.
note: Includes appointment-fee billing for clinic reception workflows.

title: Universal Downloader
label: MEDIA DOWNLOADS
description: A media downloader with link analysis, quality selection, audio extraction and resumable downloads.
detail: Universal Downloader uses yt-dlp with platform-specific media tools to download selected video and audio formats on Windows and Android. Local history, thumbnail saving and download controls keep the workflow in one Flutter interface.
note: Video and audio formats are selected from those made available by the source.

title: Off Chat
label: OFFLINE MESSAGING
description: An offline messenger with encrypted local chat, resumable file sharing and direct Wi-Fi voice and video calls.
detail: Off Chat runs its mesh engine inside the Windows and Android apps, with no separate server required for local messaging. English and Myanmar interfaces bring together groups, local discovery, file transfers and direct calls.
features: Direct Wi-Fi voice and video calls
note: Voice and video connect over local Wi-Fi, LAN or a hotspot.

title: LumaShelf
label: OFFLINE LEARNING
description: A personal offline learning library for browsing enrolled courses and managing resumable course downloads.
detail: LumaShelf provides a native Flutter interface for an enrolled Udemy library on Windows and Android. Course search, curriculum selection and a persistent download queue work with platform-encrypted session storage.
note: Native Flutter adaptation derived from UdemySaver, with support for downloadable MP4 lectures and course resources.

title: ATOM Forensic Pro
label: EVIDENCE WORKSPACE
description: A Windows evidence workspace for importing, searching, verifying and reporting on acquired data.
detail: ATOM Forensic Pro brings folder and JSON imports together with explicit read-only Android acquisition through ADB. SHA-256 integrity checks, an audit log and HTML, CSV and JSON reports support evidence review.
note: Works with accessible local artifacts and explicitly authorized Android ADB acquisitions.

title: ATOM Universal Builder
label: DEVELOPER WORKSPACE
description: A desktop Flutter workspace with project tools, build commands and cloud or local AI assistance.
detail: ATOM Universal Builder combines a Go and Wails desktop shell with a React interface and Monaco editor. Build, run, test and doctor commands sit alongside project search, Git tools, extensions and AI Ask and Agent workflows.
features: Flutter build, run, test and doctor
note: Windows desktop workspace with macOS and Linux build targets.

title: AI SRT Editor
label: SUBTITLES & VIDEO
description: A subtitle and video editor with timeline caption editing, AI translation and styled exports.
detail: AI SRT Editor brings caption timing, text editing and subtitle styles into a Flutter workspace for Windows and Android. A project library, autosave and undo support ongoing edits, with SRT, VTT, TXT and MP4 export options.
features: SRT, VTT, TXT and MP4 export
